name: DBB_ANTsCortThickSeg
summary: Segments brain tissues in a T1-weighted image with a customized ANTs antsCorticalThickness.sh using Pediatric Template of Brain Perfusion (PTBP) priors and an optional brain mask, and outputs a tissue segmentation.
description: Runs stages 1-3 of a customized antsCorticalThickness.sh (ANTs 2.2.0) with the PTBP template and six tissue priors bundled in the repo; when a brain mask is given it replaces the template-based brain extraction. Developed for the Distorted Brain Benchmark (DBB) of paediatric patients with brain malformations. It needs a T1w image; the output is the ANTs BrainSegmentation volume with a label.json.

inputs.description: Optional brain mask used instead of the template-based brain extraction.
inputs.requirements: Must be in the same space as the T1.

outputs.description: Brain tissue segmentation (segmentation.nii.gz, ANTs BrainSegmentation) with label.json.

citations.text: Amorosino G, Peruzzo D, Redaelli D, Olivetti E, Arrigoni F, Avesani P. DBB - A Distorted Brain Benchmark for Automatic Tissue Segmentation in Paediatric Patients. NeuroImage 119486 (2022).
